description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {B}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Samwise the Stouthearted.
Repeat.
